description: You're apartment hunting and need to make a decision! Create a comparison spreadsheet from the rough notes in ~/Documents/Spreadsheets/apartment_notes.txt. Your spreadsheet must include: (1) A bold header row with columns for Apartment Name, Base Rent, Utilities Cost, Parking Cost, Total Monthly Cost, Commute Time, and Key Feature. (2) One row per apartment (5 total). (3) A formula in the 'Total Monthly Cost' column that adds Base Rent + Utilities + Parking. (4) Complete data for all apartments including commute times and key features. Save to ~/Documents/Spreadsheets/apartment_comparison.xlsx
